notes.title: Platypus Reclayed is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Platypus is back 23 years later from the Original Developer Anthony Flack![/b][/h3][p]You can play Platypus Reclayed NOW on PC, Mac, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch
[/p][previewyoutube="Qq4fCHFMKTg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
23 years after its first appearance, led by the original creator [b]Anthony Flack[/b] alongside the Claymatic team, Platypus Reclayed isn't just a simple remaster - [b]it's a complete revamp[/b]: 
[/p][p][b]Reprogrammed from scratch and updated for modern hardware..[/b] [/p][p]Platypus Reclayed is moulded from the ground up with all-new models and artwork photographed in 4k widescreen, featuring updated gameplay, new weapons and additional content. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2912430/Platypus_Reclayed/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Experience claytastic arcade style mayhem with engrossing retro vibes - The cult shoot-em-up Platypus is back in all its clayful glory. 👏[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Modding | Community-made fun![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6593986/43d5a3a2008d7f434389c5083a7da650d7d2907f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]We loved the mods and fan art you made for the original game - This time, we've got your back.[/b][/p][p]We've made Platypus Reclayed with the intent of allowing you to create your own custom-made mods - Visit our [url="https://platypus-modding.claymatic.games/"][b]Modding Guide[/b][/url]![/p][h3][b]
BLAST-OFF![/b] [/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6593986/369cdb27ca519a7bf9fb51cfa75957d2d02f3aec.png"][/img][/p][p]From all of us at Claymatic Games, thank you so much for your support on our journey - We hope you enjoy Platypus Reclayed - Blast Off! 🚀 🧡[/p][p][/p][p][b]Share your Platypus Adventures with us across our socials:[/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/claymatic"][b]Discord[/b][/url][b] [/b]•[b] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ClaymaticGames"]YouTube[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://www.instagram.com/claymaticgames"]Instagram [/url][/b]•[b] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@claymaticgames?lang=en"]TikTok[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/claymatic.games"]Bluesky [/url][/b]•[b] [url="https://twitter.com/ClaymaticGames"]Twitter[/url][/b][/p]
